Amazon Warns NYC Delivery Bill Could Increase Order Costs

Amazon has stated that a proposed New York City Council bill could increase the cost of each delivery order by up to $5. The bill, which is under consideration, would require last-mile delivery operators to be licensed by the city and to directly employ their workers instead of using contractors. Amazon has initiated an in-app campaign against the bill, which is reportedly backed by Councilmember Shahana Najmi.
